title: Photos of the Week: Night Harvest, Heavy Surf, Pumpkin Kong
text:
Wang He / Getty

 Wingsuit flyer Michael Brewer of the U.S. trial jumps off a mountain to hit a target during the 12th World Wind Loading China Grand Prix on September 10, 2026, in Zhangjiajie, China.

 Adam Gray / Getty

 A person wears a giant butterfly costume during the annual West Indian Day Parade on September 7, 2026, in the Brooklyn borough of New York City.

 Noah Lantor / AP

 Florida State students react during a stadium-wide power outage before an NCAA college football game against Southern Methodist University in Tallahassee, Florida, on September 7, 2026.

 Frank Hammerschmidt / DPA / Getty

 A praying mantis perches on the stem of a heather plant in the Lieberose Heath in Brandenburg, Germany, on September 8, 2026.

 Ebrahim Noroozi / AP

 Paige Bueckers of Team USA talks to China’s Zhang Ziyu during the Women’s Basketball World Cup match between China and the United States in Berlin, Germany, on September 4, 2026. The official listed height of Ziyu (age 19) is 7 feet 4 inches (223 cm).

 Joao Luiz Bulcao / Hans Lucas / AFP / Getty

 A tourist poses for a photograph overlooking Rio de Janeiro from Corcovado, Brazil, on September 5, 2026, with Sugarloaf Mountain visible in the background.

 Eric Gay / AP

 The University of Texas mascot, Bevo, is brought onto the field by handlers for an NCAA college-football game between the University of Texas and Texas State University in Austin, Texas, on September 5, 2026.

 Marco Ugarte / AP

 A blacksmith prepares horseshoes during the annual Charro Fest, a traditional Mexican rodeo, at the Lienzo Charro Constituyentes arena in Mexico City, Mexico, on September 5, 2026.

 Özkan Bilgin / Anadolu / Getty

 Local shepherds and villagers pass through snow tunnels measuring up to 40 meters long, formed beneath unmelted snow masses even late into the summer, to care for their livestock in the high-altitude pastures of the Bahçesaray district in Van, Turkey, on September 3, 2026.

 Laurent Cipriani / AP

 Tourists walk in the ice cave of the Mer de Glace glacier, at Montenvers station in Chamonix, France, on September 5, 2026.

 Patricia De Melo Moreira / AFP / Getty

 Workers from the Herdade das Servas winery take part in a nighttime grape harvest in Estremoz, Portugal, on September 3, 2026. Night harvesting is a strategic wine-making technique adopted mainly in regions with very hot climates, such as the Alentejo or the Douro, where summer daytime temperatures can exceed 104 degrees Fahrenheit. Harvesting grapes between sunset and sunrise offers technical advantages for wine quality and winery sustainability.

 Pavel Bednyakov / AP

 A worker lifts a giant pumpkin during a weigh-in competition at the Battle of Giants harvest festival in Moscow, Russia, on September 10, 2026.

 Michael Bahlo / DPA / Getty

 Daniel Brehmer carves a face into a pumpkin at the Klaistow Adventure Farm in Brandenburg, Germany, on September 5, 2026.

 Michael Bahlo / DPA / Getty

 A visitor takes a photo of a King Kong figure made of pumpkins at the Klaistow Adventure Farm in Brandenburg on September 5, 2026.

 Heather Khalifa / AP

 A member of the Belmont Baby Dolls poses for a photo before the start of the West Indian Day Parade on September 7, 2026, in Brooklyn, New York.

 Leon Neal / Getty

 A heavily tattooed man prepares to display his body art during the Big London Tattoo Show at ExCel London on September 5, 2026, in London, England.

 Kostiantyn Liberov / Libkos / Getty

 Firefighters deal with the aftermath of a massive Russian missile and drone attack on September 8, 2026, in Kyiv, Ukraine.

 Vlada Liberova / Libkos / Getty

 Nine-month-old Noi, the son of Ukrainian photographers Kostiantyn Liberov and Vlada Liberova, plays by a window as smoke rises outside following a Russian missile and drone attack, on September 8, 2026 in Kyiv, Ukraine.

 Sebastian Christoph Gollnow / DPA / Getty

 A commercially available drone is shot down by a high-energy laser developed by the defense start-up Ground A, demonstrated in Berlin, Germany, on September 7, 2026.

 David Santiago / AP

 An Amazon cargo plane sits on its nose at Miami International Airport after overshooting a runway on September 7, 2026, in Miami, Florida.

 Reina / AFP / Getty

 A resident wearing a Spider-Man costume extinguishes a wildfire at Kereng Bangkirai in Palangkaraya, Central Kalimantan, Indonesia, on September 9, 2026. Toxic haze has shrouded parts of Indonesia and Malaysia for weeks as Jakarta struggles to contain fires that have scorched large tracts of Borneo and Sumatra.

 Moises Castillo / AP

 New National Civil Police officers attend their graduation ceremony in Guatemala City, Guatemala, on September 9, 2026.

 Indranil Mukherjee / AFP / Getty

 Hindu devotees prepare to form a human pyramid to break a suspended curd pot on the occasion of Krishna Janmashtami festival in Mumbai, India, on September 5, 2026.

 Debarchan Chatterjee / NurPhoto / Getty

 Devotees take part in a traditional pot-breaking ritual to celebrate Janmashtami, the birthday of Lord Krishna, in Kolkata, India, on September 5, 2026.

 Mario Tama / Getty

 An aerial view of a Pacific Ocean wave crashing into a seawall protecting beachside homes in Long Beach, California, on September 7, 2026. Heavy surf generated by offshore Hurricane Marie, during a record-breaking period of ocean heat and an emerging El Niño, caused minor coastal flooding along the Long Beach Peninsula.

 AFP / Getty

 Solar panels stand above ponds in Yangzhou, in China’s eastern Jiangsu province, on September 9, 2026.

 Muhammad Amdad Hossain / NurPhoto / Getty

 An aerial view shows workers spreading and drying small fish on traditional bamboo racks under the sun in Cox’s Bazar, Chittagong Division, Bangladesh, on September 4, 2026.

 Aaron Favila / AP

 A dog named Hartly wears a costume during a “Dog Pawshion Show” in Manila, Philippines, on September 4, 2026.
